compositions.summary: The entire canvas is a single colored stage. A dominant artifact occupies roughly the middle 55-80% height and 50-99% width. A micro header row sits at 2-6% height; a fixed three-column info grid anchors the bottom at 89-97% height.

header.content: brand left, site right, one line, tiny caps

stage.object: one dominant artifact, horizontally centered, vertically spanning most of the stage

footer.content: identity block / first fact column / second fact column

compositions.fallback: full-bleed brand field, centered artifact, three-column footer

compositions.summary: The artifact bleeds to all edges and becomes the stage; type is reversed out of it or set in solid blocks on top.

header.content: minimal, often only brand and site

stage.object: full-bleed photograph or illustration with internal type blocks

compositions.fallback: full-bleed image with one large type block at 44-56% height

compositions.summary: A near-paper field holds one contained centered artifact at roughly 50-76% width and 20-79% height; generous equal margins.
compositions.fallback: paper field, centered artifact at 60% width, standard footer
